mapper.sql: select notify_id, title, content, notify_type, biz_module, biz_id, receiver, receiver_name, is_read, read_time, create_by, create_time, remark from jc_notify_message
mapper.insert: insert into jc_notify_message (title, content, notify_type, biz_module, biz_id, receiver, receiver_name, is_read, read_time, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{title}, #{content}, #{notifyType}, #{bizModule}, #{bizId}, #{receiver}, #{receiverName}, '0', null, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.select: select count(*) from jc_notify_message where receiver = #{receiver} and is_read = '0'
mapper.update: update jc_notify_message set is_read = '1', read_time = sysdate() where notify_id = #{notifyId} and receiver = #{receiver} and is_read = '0'
update jc_notify_message set is_read = '1', read_time = sysdate() where receiver = #{receiver} and is_read = '0'
mapper.delete: delete from jc_notify_message where notify_id = #{notifyId} and receiver = #{receiver}
delete from jc_notify_message where receiver = #{receiver} and is_read = '1'
delete from jc_notify_message where is_read = '1' and read_time < date_sub(curdate(), interval #{days} day)
mapper.select: select distinct u.user_name from sys_user u join sys_user_role ur on ur.user_id = u.user_id join sys_role r on r.role_id = ur.role_id where r.role_key = #{roleKey} and r.status = '0' and u.status = '0' and u.del_flag = '0'
select nick_name from sys_user where user_name = #{userName} and del_flag = '0' limit 1
select notify_type as notifyType, count(*) as unread from jc_notify_message where receiver = #{receiver} and is_read = '0' group by notify_type order by unread desc
